metadata.syllabus_name: UI/UX Design_Thiết kế trải nghiệm người dùng
metadata.time_allocation: Study hour (150h) = 84h online + 3h offline + 1h TE + 62 h self-study
metadata.description: Integrate UX Research and UX Design to create great products through understanding user needs, rapidly generating prototypes, and evaluating design concepts. Students will gain hands-on experience with taking a product from initial concept, through user research, ideation and refinement, formal analysis, prototyping, and user testing, applying perspectives and methods to ensure a great user experience at every step. This course concludes with a capstone project, in which learners will incorporate UX Research and Design principles to design a complete product, taking it from an initial concept to an interactive prototype.
metadata.student_tasks:
1. Complete the online courses and get all specialization certifications to be allowed to take Final Exam
2. Final Exam included Final Theory Exam (TE):  100%
3. Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.
4. Completion Criteria:  Final TE Score  >=4 & (Final TE Score + bonus) >= 5

materials.note: MOOC 1: Introduction to User Experience Principles and Processes
MOOC 4: UX Design: From Concept to Prototype
MOOC 5: UX Research at Scale: Surveys, Analytics, Online Testing
SPEC: User Experience Research and Design

clos.lo_details: Be able to explain what is involved in UX research, including conducting interviews, evaluating systems, and analyzing systems using principles of good design
Be able to describe about the work involved in UX Design, including the generation of promising design solutions and the creation of prototypes at multiple levels of fidelity
Be able to describe numerous techniques to gather data from and about users
Know how to design and conduct tests with users
Be able to apply techniques such as sketching, scenario development, storyboarding, and wireframing
Know how to turn wireframes and interaction architecture into interactive prototypes that can be tested with prospective users and iteratively refined into a high quality design
Be able to describe techniques for gaining UX insights from large numbers of users, including web analytics, A/B testing, and remote unmoderated studies
Know how to design and carry out an integrated multi-phase user experience research and design project
